// 'In A only' = present in SOURCE but not TARGET -> rows to INSERT into target.
return items.map(i => ({ json: { action: 'INSERT', table: 'target', ...i.json } }));

// 'Same' = key matches and all compared fields equal -> nothing to do.
return items.map(i => ({ json: { action: 'NOOP', table: 'target', ...i.json } }));

// 'In B only' = present in TARGET but not SOURCE -> rows to DELETE from target.
return items.map(i => ({ json: { action: 'DELETE', table: 'target', ...i.json } }));
